guarantees.claim: u_prim_buf_out drives out_buf from out through a prim_buf buffer with width NumOutBufBits.

assumptions.claim: NumOutBufBits must match the actual bit width of signals out and out_buf.
assumptions.risk: Width mismatch can cause high-order bits to be dropped or excess zero padding, corrupting output data.

uncertain_points.claim: The insertion of a prim_buf primitive is not explained; its exact function (simple wire, register slice, isolation cell) is unclear.
uncertain_points.risk: If the buffer introduces unintended latency or combinational glitch filtering, downstream logic relying on immediate data stability could malfunction.

uncertain_points.claim: The parameter NumOutBufBits is used to set the buffer width, but its value may not be enforced to match the declared widths of out and out_buf.
uncertain_points.cond: when NumOutBufBits differs from the wire widths
uncertain_points.risk: Silent truncation or zero-extension could occur, altering the AES output data path.
